en:
## Bug Fixes

- Preserved completed text when interrupting a run mid-tool-call so flushed output is no longer lost on abort.
- Fixed a race where error messages could appear without a reference and report "Message not found" after a page refresh.

## New Features

- Subagents can now switch model and reasoning effort at runtime, picked up on the next request.
- Rejecting a file-based plan now shows tailored guidance to revise the plan file instead of rewriting inline.

## Performance

- Slimmed down the tool-call card header with native elements and added aria-expanded for better accessibility.
- Cached i18n language resolution hot paths to reduce overhead during fast scrolling.
zh-CN:
## 修复

- 在工具调用中途打断时保留已完成文本，中断不再丢失已 flush 的输出。
- 修复错误消息可能缺少引用、刷新页面后报“Message not found”的竞态问题。

## 新功能

- 子代理支持运行时切换模型和推理强度，在下次请求时生效。
- 拒绝文件模式计划时显示针对性提示，引导修改计划文件而非内联重写。

## 性能优化

- 使用原生元素精简工具调用卡片头部，并补充 aria-expanded 提升可访问性。
- 缓存 i18n 语言解析热路径，降低快速滚动时的开销。
